rachats.citation: In May 2023, Edenred acquired Reward Gateway, a UK-based employee engagement platform, for an enterprise value of GBP 1.15 billion
In November 2018, Edenred announced the acquisition of Corporate Spending Innovations, an electronic B2B payments company, for $600 million
Edenred also launched its Corporate Payment Services business and acquired Embratec's operations in Brazil

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
